{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_new_paid_search = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'].str.lower() == 'new') & 
                               (df_clean['channel'].str.lower() == 'paid_search')]

# Compute conversion fraction
total_new_paid_search = len(df_new_paid_search)
converted_count = (df_new_paid_search['converted'] == 1).sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_count / total_new_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"Total NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (after cleaning): {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction:.4f}")

# Return the value for submission
conversion_fraction"}
